facts.fact: TechCabal says BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 has applied since January 2024 and obliges every fintech offering payment services in the UEMOA to obtain a licence or stop, after the deadline was postponed to 31 August 2025.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: TechCabal reports Togolese fintech Semoa received the BCEAO level 3 full payment institution licence on 29 January 2026, and that INTOUCH Togo was licensed in June 2025.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
